active_law: Commerce should be drawn from every commerce signal already present in source files, but only after transformation into Whispers of Willow and Stone-exclusive form. Valid signals include markets, vendors, farms, trade, craft, guilds, routes, tolls, stock, caravans, barter, quality, scarcity, price, repair, food, animals, medicines, tools, textiles, metal, stone, song, glass, glyph-work, and local trust.
implementation_note: Use this as active crawl/scoring law. Do not treat source commercial signals as usable canon until transformed into world-native WoWaS commerce.

active_law: No brands, franchise goods, trademarked names, recognizable commercial product identities, or thinly disguised outside commercial IP may enter active canon unless the result is fully Whispers of Willow and Stone-exclusive and no longer depends on the outside identity. Generic roles, materials, goods, trade behaviors, farm functions, craft systems, and scarcity patterns are allowed. Borrowed commercial identities are blocked.
implementation_note: Reject borrowed commercial identity. Permit transformed generic trade function, material pressure, scarcity pattern, or world-native craft equivalent.

active_law: The commerce layer is not finished yet. Do not pretend it is final, and do not write final commerce prose from this layer alone. Use it as active constraints for crawling, scoring, and later registry construction.
implementation_note: This file is a constraint layer, not the final commerce registry or prose authority by itself.

active_law: Commerce must not collapse into Pip attraction logic. Pip may overpay or revisit a hot male merchant when quality is close, but better quality, rarer goods, higher trust, or stronger craft wins even when the merchant is female or not Pip's preferred type. Quality, trust, rarity, fair price, region fit, and Pip-gravity must remain separate scored fields.
implementation_note: Generator/scoring fields required: quality_score, trust_score, rarity_score, fair_price_score, region_fit_score, pip_gravity_score, final_selection_reason.

active_law: Add Chow as chicken-cows, cow-chickens, and every stable or unstable stage between. They formed because chickens and cows were kept together long enough under post-Diamond pressure that they heavily played on each other's psyche and morphology until the boundary became a full livestock spectrum.
implementation_note: Chow are a livestock-spectrum species category, not a one-off gag creature.

active_law: Chow can range from cow-to-chicken, chicken-to-cow, clean blend, ugly blend, hysterical mismatch, useful farm breed, dangerous barn mutant, sacred rural omen, or intelligent near-person. Saved Chow entries still need ecology, farm use, temperament, and visual silhouette.
implementation_note: Every saved Chow must include ecology, farm use, temperament, and visual silhouette. Do not save form-only novelty entries.

active_law: Most Chow are livestock-level creatures. A few walk around intelligent, socially aware, stubborn, trade-aware, or nearly conversational. Intelligent Chow should be uncommon and should create farm politics, inheritance disputes, labor ethics, market scandal, or rural comedy instead of becoming random mascots.
implementation_note: Intelligent Chow are uncommon plot/commerce/social pressure. Do not overpopulate them or mascot-flatten them.

active_law: Chow are a major farm-and-commerce animal category, not just a joke creature. Their eggs, milk, meat, feathers, hide, manure, labor, alarm behavior, and rare intelligence can create trade value, taboo, theft, quality grades, and local law.
implementation_note: Chow goods and Chow personhood edge-cases should drive farm law, market scandal, theft, taboo, grades, and local disputes.

active_law: WoWaS politics should use a post-world-apocalypse hybrid pressure: Germanic tribal conversion point into more formal structure, Mongolian raider mobility and oath pressure, Chinese house-system hierarchy, and early Gaelic representation, all transformed into world-native post-Diamond social order. This is inspiration logic only, not direct historical copy or real-world naming dump.
implementation_note: Use as transformed inspiration pressure only. Do not import real-world naming dumps or direct historical copies.

active_law: Political units should include houses, clans, mobile oath-bands, farm holds, gate-toll families, market circles, healer circles, raider-converted protectors, and rebuilt councils. A house is not only a noble family; it can be craft, bloodline, oath, route-control, ecological duty, old survival debt, or post-Blood-Cello accountability.
implementation_note: Use these unit types in political/commerce scene placement and future registry construction.

active_law: Representation should feel early, local, voiced, oath-bound, and messy. Speakers carry family, farm, road, creature, healer, market, and survival interests into councils. Do not make it modern parliament, corporate guilds, or clean fantasy kingdoms.
implementation_note: Council scenes should feel local and pressure-bound, not modern/corporate/clean monarchy default.

active_law: Raider bands can convert into disciplined protection houses, mobile trade guarantors, toll enforcers, messenger routes, and harsh border justice systems. Keep mobility, horse/pack/herd logic, oath pressure, and tactical speed; do not flatten into generic barbarians.
implementation_note: Converted raider structures may become civic infrastructure while retaining speed, oath pressure, tactical threat, and herd/pack logistics.

active_law: Tribal identity should be in a conversion point: kinship, oath, assembly, chieftain pressure, honor debt, blood-price logic, and emerging law competing with rebuilt civic structure.
implementation_note: Use this as a legitimacy/conflict engine between survival kinship and rebuilt civic order.

active_law: House identity should also carry archive, hierarchy, apprenticeship, intergenerational duty, ancestor/accountability pressure, resource control, and ceremonial face, blended into WoWaS without copying real dynasties.
implementation_note: House systems are not only nobility. Apply craft, archive, duty, resource, route, and accountability functions.

active_law: Future generator passes should create large unsaved raw candidate pools, then select only top active canon through hierarchy: raw candidate -> local pool -> regional pool -> faction/house pool -> book/volume placement -> active canon winner. Raw candidate pools are process material, not canon files.
implementation_note: Save active winners and compact score summaries only. Do not preserve raw candidate farms in final active canon.

active_law: For active character and creature canon, the target quality pattern is top one percent: 5,000 saved winners should be selected from about 500,000 raw candidates per lane when the device budget allows. Save active winners and compact score summaries only, not the whole raw pool.
implementation_note: Device budget permitting, use 500,000 raw candidates per lane to select 5,000 active winners. Raw pools are not final canon.

active_law: Do not change the static beats originally set. The main story must progress as it already did. Add the other characters, add more content, add commerce/politics/Chow/event pressure, and add more events without changing the established path, series titles, arc titles, or main progression.
implementation_note: This update must enrich the existing path. It must not rename series/arcs/books or rewrite the core beat order.
